title: Yama
one_line: The first limb of ashtanga yoga, consisting of five ethical restraints.
points: Yama is the first of the eight limbs of ashtanga yoga.
It consists of five parts: ahimsa; satya; asteya; brahmacharya; and aparigraha.

Guruji writes that each of the five sub-limbs is associated with yama, the first limb, and that only the actions of previous lives will lead us to practice them; the mind turns to the practice of yoga only when a samskara or vasana is present.
Even where a samskara exists, aspirants must expect to practice the yogic steps with effort.
